name: Ukraine
exam_name: Іспити з основ Конституції України та історії України
administering_agency: Науково-методичний центр вищої та фахової передвищої освіти (Ministry of Education and Science)

format.notes: Two examinations in one session, 45 minutes each: 20 tasks on the basics of the Constitution (15 needed) and 25 on the history of Ukraine (20 needed). The published bank has 350 questions: 160 on the Constitution and 190 on history.

official_study_material.title: База тестових завдань до іспитів з основ Конституції України та історії України (350 питань)

unverified.languages: Assumed Ukrainian; a state-language requirement is separate.
unverified.format.modes: Applicants register through an electronic cabinet; how the test is sat was not read. "computer" is an assumption.
unverified.format.pass_mark: The task counts and pass marks come from a search summary of the migration service’s notice; the lines read directly confirm the 350-question bank and its split.

recent_change.summary: The migration service set out the new examination rules in a notice of 3 February 2025: programmes approved by a ministry order of 2 October 2024, under Cabinet resolution 620 of 2024, with a bank of 350 test questions.
